lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Spring, after the Coinwater. Every battle|of this war had soaked into the ground.
lines.text: Spring, after the Coinwater. Every battle of this war had soaked into the ground.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: And the ground ran one way.|Down, into the Hollow.
lines.text: And the ground ran one way. Down, into the Hollow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The war itself was opening the door.
lines.text: The war itself was opening the door.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Hear me, Bishop. No more whispers.|Every battle you fought, I drank.
lines.text: Hear me, Bishop. No more whispers. Every battle you fought, I drank.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: You've found your voice. Pity.|I liked you better as a whisper.
lines.text: You've found your voice. Pity. I liked you better as a whisper.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: He can't hold it. Not alone. Not any more.
lines.text: He can't hold it. Not alone. Not any more.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Then he won't be. Ashby! Your fastest messenger.
lines.text: Then he won't be. Ashby! Your fastest messenger.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: The Orb goes north to Torvald.|It lay in his lake. It's his to carry.
lines.text: The Orb goes north to Torvald. It lay in his lake. It's his to carry.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Tell him: we need all four of you.
lines.text: Tell him: we need all four of you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: The Signet slept in Ysolde's tree.|Take it home to her, Wren.
lines.text: The Signet slept in Ysolde's tree. Take it home to her, Wren.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: You gave two away. Without|a fight. Are you ill, girl?
lines.text: You gave two away. Without a fight. Are you ill, girl?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Three keys. The fourth is in Malrik's pocket.
lines.text: Three keys. The fourth is in Malrik's pocket.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Then we go and ask him. He asked for|all four of you. Especially Malrik.
lines.text: Then we go and ask him. He asked for all four of you. Especially Malrik.
